name: M'ONDUNIQ VASCAL 10% phytic acid concentrate
shortDescription: Professional acid exfoliating concentrate with 10% phytic acid (pH ~1.35) for sensitive, dehydrated skin and skin prone to pigmentation and capillary problems. 50 ml.
description:
A professional acid exfoliating concentrate with 10% phytic acid, developed primarily for the care of sensitive and dehydrated skin, skin prone to discolouration and pigmentation, and skin with capillary problems.

Phytic acid supports the skin's natural exfoliation process, thereby contributing to a smoother, more even and more radiant complexion. It helps fade the visibility of existing hyperpigmentation and prevent excessive pigmentation from developing. It supports the skin's hydration and elasticity, while helping to regulate sebum production and reduce the visibility of fine wrinkles.

It is a low-pH professional acid product, so its use requires particular care.

features.title: How to use
features.description: After thorough skin cleansing, apply the Mousse 6% preparation product recommended by the manufacturer, then dry the skin. Apply the concentrate with a soft brush to the face, neck and décolleté, avoiding the eye and mouth area. Leave on for 5–10 minutes, then rinse off thoroughly with lukewarm water. After the treatment, applying a soothing/nourishing product suited to the skin's needs is recommended.
